# glad

OpenGL function loader, generated by [glad 2](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) v2.0.8 for OpenGL 4.1 core
with no extensions, using the web service at <https://gen.glad.sh/>. The command line and the link to
the same settings are at the top of `include/glad/gl.h`. The files are generated code: don't edit them by
hand. They are left out of `format` and `lint`. See [docs/DECISIONS.md](../../docs/DECISIONS.md) for
why glad is used.

`Window` calls `gladLoadGL` once its OpenGL context is current. Before that, every OpenGL function is a
null pointer.

## Generating again

Needed when the OpenGL version changes or an extension is needed. Either use the web service at
<https://gen.glad.sh/> (language C/C++, API gl, profile core, version 4.1, no options), or run the Python
tool from a glad 2 checkout (it needs Jinja2):

```sh
git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.0.8 https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad.git /tmp/glad
PYTHONPATH=/tmp/glad python3 -m glad --api gl:core=4.1 --out-path external/glad --reproducible c
```

`--reproducible` uses the OpenGL registry (`gl.xml`) that comes with glad instead of downloading the
newest one, so the same glad version always gives the same files. The committed files came from the web
service, so the Python tool gives a different comment at the top of `gl.h`, and its `gl.xml` may differ
from the one the web service used. The functions of OpenGL 4.1 core are the same either way.
